brief: Write ui/avatar.brain: shows a user's photo and name given by its parent; it never changes them.
Write comp/rating-input.brain: 1–5 star picker whose selected value the parent reads and can also set (two-way).
Write comp/file-row.brain: shows a file name with a Delete button; the parent decides what deleting means.
Write ui/card.brain: a bordered container with a title area and a footer area whose content the parent supplies.
Write comp/search-box.brain: an input the parent can programmatically focus and clear (e.g. on Ctrl+K).
Write comp/price-tag.brain: displays a price in the currency chosen at the top of the app (MXN/USD); it is nested 5 levels deep. Also write channels/currency.jsbrain if needed.
Write channels/favorites.jsbrain and comp/fav-button.brain: a heart button on product cards; a header badge elsewhere in the app shows the favorites count; keep it across tabs.
Write channels/analytics.jsbrain and comp/buy-button.brain: clicking Buy fires an analytics event that several unrelated listeners may log; nothing is stored.
